life-diary.description:
A local-first, open source Android diary app built on one principle: no feature is forced on you.
Use all 20 features or just write. Your choice, always.
What you can use — if you want:
Daily writing streaks and weekly stats
Photos, videos, and voice recordings
Location and weather context
Google Fit step count
Locked and hidden entries
Custom fonts and text colors
Freehand canvas drawing
Cover photos
Multi-account support
What we never do:
No cloud storage
No data collection
No ads
No surveillance
No forced features
Your data never leaves your device. Ever.
Open source — check the code yourself.
Built by a 16-year-old developer from Bursa, Turkey.
